Music
At Thornton Grove Academy, we know that music is a special language that brings joy, creativity and a strong sense of community to our school.
Our music curriculum is designed to inspire every child’s passion for music. We encourage students to develop their skills and explore different ways to express themselves through singing, playing instruments and creating music.
Music plays an important role in helping children grow. It supports their thinking skills, boosts confidence and teaches them how to work well with others. More than just sounds and songs, music helps children discover who they are and how to share their feelings.
At Thornton Grove Academy, we believe every child has a unique musical voice - and we’re here to help them find it.

Art
At Thornton Grove Academy, we are passionate about nurturing the artistic talents and creative expression of every child.
Art is more than just creating images - it is a powerful form of self-expression, exploration and communication. Our art curriculum introduces students to a broad range of artistic styles, mediums and techniques. From painting and drawing to sculpture and digital art, children are encouraged to experiment, express themselves and develop their own artistic voices.
We celebrate creativity in all its forms, helping students to grow in confidence and appreciate the value of visual storytelling. At Thornton Grove Academy, we believe every child is an artist - and there are no limits to what they can imagine and create.

Physical Education
At Thornton Grove Academy, we provide an energetic and inclusive physical education program that encourages students to live healthy, active lives.
Physical education supports children’s development by improving fitness, coordination and motor skills. It also teaches important values like teamwork, sportsmanship and confidence.
Our curriculum offers a wide range of activities - from team sports like netball and cricket to individual pursuits such as gymnastics and dance - giving every child the chance to find their passion and grow their skills.
We also highlight the strong connection between physical activity and mental well-being. Regular exercise helps reduce stress, sharpen focus, and boost overall health. Our students learn that being active is good for both body and mind.
Through PE, we aim to inspire lifelong healthy habits, teaching the importance of exercise, balanced nutrition, and staying active throughout life.

Reception
We endeavour to support children so that they become confident, independent and balanced individuals who are able to reach their full potential in all areas of their development. In order to do this, we work hard to provide high quality provision both indoors and outdoors in order to develop a love of learning. This provision is set within a safe and stimulating environment where diversity is celebrated and achievements are recognised.
The Early Years Foundation Stage Curriculum
At Thornton Grove Academy, we use the Early Years Foundation Stage Statutory Framework to inform and support our planning and to enhance our assessment procedures. This guidance sets out the Early Learning Goals which children are expected to achieve by the end of reception. There are three prime areas and four specific areas included within the Early Learning Goals.
Communication and Language underpins all learning. We understand the importance of supporting and facilitating back-and-forth interactions from an early age. At Thornton Grove Academy, children are supported by their peers and adults throughout the day in a language-rich environment. Practitioners will regularly comment on what children are doing, incorporate new vocabulary into conversations and echo back what children say, adding additional vocabulary as they do so. In both nursery and reception, children in engage in both rhyme time and story time each day, allowing them to become immersed in language. Children enjoy actively participating in these sessions whether through actions, discussions or song. Within our provision, we also ensure that children have a variety of opportunity to engage in role play alongside their peers, developing their own story telling and use of communication. We endeavour to make our role plays areas exciting and stimulating for the children, but role-play can happen anywhere. Practitioners enjoying engaging with children during role play or small world play through modelling or questioning, which allows children to elaborate on their story-telling and become more confident within the language structures that they use.
PSED (personal, social emotional development) is critical for very young children in all aspects of their lives and gives them the best opportunity for successes in all areas of learning. At Thornton Grove Academy, we strive to ensure that all children learn the skills necessary in order to work, play and co-operate with others. Children should feel safe, secure and respect themselves and others in order to develop a positive self-image. In Early Years, children learn how to build relationships with peers and adults and begin to understand how to express and regulate their emotions. As practitioners, our aim is to support and develop this through the delivery of safe and stimulating curriculum. Children will also learn how to look after their bodies, including how to eat healthily and how to manage their personal needs independently.
Physical Development is vital in a child’s all-round development. At Thornton Grove Academy, we understand that through developing a child’s physical skills, they will be able to pursue happy, healthy and active lives. Our curriculum strives to develop both the fine and gross motor skills of a child. Fine motor skills are the ability to make movements using the small muscles in our hands and wrists. Throughout their time at Thornton Grove Academy, children will engage with numerous activities that facilitate this including using playdoh, peg boards, tweezers, fishing rods, threading, cutting etc. Fine motor control and precision helps with hand-eye co-ordination, which is later linked to early literacy.
Gross motor skills involve using large muscles in our torso, legs and arms in a coordinated way. Within our setting, children are encouraged to practise their climbing and balance skills using our outdoor apparatus and are given time to explore, experiment and refine movements within a safe, planned and well-resourced learning environment. Our practitioners create games and provide opportunities for play both indoors and outdoors, to support children to develop their core strength, stability, balance, spatial awareness, co-ordination and agility.
In Early Years, we form the stepping stones for all children to learn the foundations of literacy. We teach the children the skills they need to build and develop their phonological awareness. At Thornton Grove Academy, we provide children with lots of opportunities around their environment to mark make, write and read. It is crucial for children to develop a life-long love of reading and we embed this through teaching children songs, poems and rhymes. During these sessions, we teach essential comprehension skills to enhance inference and speech development. We understand the relationship between physical development and writing and so we offer a wide range of activities for children to strengthen their pencil grip in order to become fluent writers.
Mathematics teaches essential life-long skills for all children to develop and excel in. We provide children with high quality provision that is both resourceful and accessible. Children are taught how to count confidently, develop a deep understanding of the numbers to 10 and the relationships between them, including the patterns within those numbers. By providing frequent and varied opportunities to build and apply this understanding, children will develop a secure base of knowledge and vocabulary from which mathematics is built. At Thornton Grove Academy, we aim to provide rich opportunities where children learn across all areas of mathematics. It is vital that children develop positive attitudes and interests in mathematics, observing patterns, relationships and spotting connections.
Understanding the World focuses on guiding children to make sense of their physical world and their community. At Thornton Grove Academy, we encourage the children to share their experiences from home, to help broaden everyone’s knowledge and understanding of different cultures and heritages. We learn about different celebrations throughout the year and encourage the children to try foods from around the world. We endeavor to ensure that our resources reflect our diverse community, allowing every child to see themselves. We spend time looking at different people in our community and use our role-play areas to provide hands-on experiences. Our children can be anything from firefighters to postal workers, police officers to bus drivers or even doctors and vets. This helps to build their knowledge and develop their vocabulary, which will later support their reading comprehension. Practitioners facilitate children’s natural curiosity through providing opportunities for children to explore the world around them, including the effect of different seasons and changes in states of matter.
Expressive Arts and Design encompasses all things creative and imaginative. At Thornton Grove Academy, we provide a rich creative environment to ensure the children have the opportunity to explore and develop their creative side. The children will have opportunities to create music, dance, sing and perform on our wonderful outside stage. They have access to a wide variety of art materials to allow them to plan and design an original piece of artwork or sculpture. We change our role-plays frequently to provide our children with broad experiences linked to our themes. The children also have opportunities to perform for their parents throughout the year.

Science
At Thornton Grove Academy, our science curriculum is designed to ignite curiosity and inspire a lifelong love of discovery. Science isn’t just a subject - it’s a way to explore and understand the world around us.
Our students embark on exciting journeys, from studying the stars in astronomy to exploring living creatures in biology. Through hands-on experiments, careful observation, and asking questions, they learn to think like real scientists - investigating, testing and drawing their own conclusions.
We also focus on the importance of caring for our planet. Students discover the role science plays in promoting sustainability and protecting the environment, gaining the knowledge and sense of responsibility to make a positive difference.

Computing
At Thornton Grove Academy, we empower young minds to thrive in the digital age.
In today’s world, computing isn’t just a subject - it’s a vital life skill that unlocks countless opportunities. Our computing curriculum equips students with essential skills in critical thinking, problem-solving and digital literacy. It’s not just about using technology, but understanding how it works - coding, creating and innovating with purpose.
We introduce coding as the language of the future. From an early age, students engage in hands-on coding projects that teach the fundamentals of programming. Whether building games, animations or websites, they develop logical thinking and creative problem-solving abilities. We encourage curiosity, experimentation and applying technology to solve real-world challenges.
Beyond technical skills, we prioritise digital citizenship and online safety. Students learn to navigate the online world responsibly and ethically. They gain a clear understanding of digital risks and how to protect themselves and others, ensuring they grow into safe, respectful and informed digital citizens.

English
At Thornton Grove Academy, we see English as a gateway to creativity, knowledge and confident communication.
Our English curriculum is designed to inspire a lifelong love of reading and writing, while equipping students with the essential language skills they need to succeed across the curriculum and in life.
Reading is at the heart of our approach. We nurture a passion for reading by immersing students in a rich variety of literature - from timeless classics to modern favourites. Through engaging stories and diverse texts, students develop empathy, imagination and a deeper understanding of the world around them.
We focus on building strong foundations. Our lessons develop key skills in reading comprehension, writing, grammar, spelling and vocabulary. These are not only vital for academic success, but also form the building blocks of clear thinking and effective self-expression.
Literature becomes a tool for exploration and expression. Students are encouraged to delve into texts, analyse themes and articulate their ideas with clarity and confidence. Whether speaking or writing, they learn to communicate with purpose and precision - an essential life skill that empowers them far beyond the classroom.
We believe education is a partnership. Parents play a crucial role in supporting their child’s English journey. We offer guidance and resources to help families foster a love of reading and learning at home, strengthening the connection between school and home.

Spanish
At Thornton Grove Academy, we believe that learning the Spanish language and culture opens doors to a world of opportunities and enriches the lives of young learners. Our primary school is dedicated to providing a comprehensive and engaging Spanish curriculum that equips students with valuable language skills.
Learning a second language is a vital asset in today’s global society, and Spanish is one of the most widely spoken languages in the world. We understand that language is more than just vocabulary and grammar; it’s a gateway to diverse cultures, communities and global understanding.
Our curriculum takes students on an exciting journey through the Spanish-speaking world. These experiences not only develop language proficiency but also deepen students’ appreciation of the rich and varied cultures across the Hispanic world.

History
History
At Thornton Grove Academy, we inspire curiosity and wonder through the exciting worlds of history.
Our carefully designed curriculum helps children explore the past, understand the present and imagine the future. We believe these subjects play a vital role in helping students make sense of the world and their place in it.
History at Thornton Grove Academy is all about discovering the incredible people, events and ideas that have shaped our world. From exploring the wonders of Ancient Egypt and the legacy of the Romans to learning about key moments like World War II, pupils travel through time to understand how the past influences our lives today. Along the way, they build important skills such as critical thinking, empathy and a respect for different cultures and perspectives.
Through history a, our students become thoughtful, informed and curious learners - ready to engage with the world around them and shape a better future

Maths
At Thornton Grove Academy, we aim to develop confident, curious and resilient mathematicians who find joy in problem-solving and discovery.
We believe that mathematics is not just about numbers - it's a powerful tool for understanding the world around us. Our goal is for every child to leave primary school with a strong mathematical foundation and the ability to apply their learning in real-life situations.
Through our lessons, children are given regular opportunities to explore maths in meaningful and practical ways. We connect mathematical concepts to other subjects and everyday experiences, helping pupils see the relevance of what they are learning and how it applies beyond the classroom.
By building fluency, reasoning and problem-solving skills, we ensure that all pupils can succeed and thrive in maths - both now and in the future.

Phonics
The rationale for linguistic phonics is that children are taught to understand the relationship between spoken language and written words. It starts with what the children naturally acquire, spoken language, and teaches them the relationship between sound-spelling correspondances.
Teaching children to read through linguistic phonics allows them to develop their decoding skills; this supports children in learning to blend graphemes (letters) for reading, segment phonemes (sounds) for spelling, and manipulate phonemes (sounds) to develop accuracy in reading and spelling.
All of our teachers receive training to deliver the Sounds-Write phonics programme. Sounds-Write takes children through systematic, incremental steps to teach children the 44 sounds in the English language and their multiple spellings.

Pupil Representation
At Thornton Grove Academy, we hold a deep and unwavering commitment to valuing pupil voice and representation. We believe that the perspective and input of our pupils are invaluable in shaping our educational environment and ensuring that it caters to their unique needs and aspirations.
pupil Parliament
Our Pupil Parliament is a dynamic and inclusive forum where the voices of our pupils truly matter. Pupil Parliament empowers young minds to shape their educational experience and school environment. Through thoughtful discussions, brainstorming sessions, and collaborative decision-making, these emerging leaders work together to address issues, propose initiatives, and foster positive change within our school community. Our Pupil Parliament is a testament to the importance of pupil engagement and democracy in education, ensuring that every pupil has a say in their school's future. Together, we strive for excellence, unity, and a brighter tomorrow.
Eco Team
The Thornton Grove Eco Team has been formed by enthusiastic members of our Year 4 class. This dedicated team of eight pupils is passionate about caring for our environment and making a positive difference around our school.
They have already begun taking on important responsibilities such as regular litter picking, and they’re eager to widen their work even further. We’re incredibly proud of their commitment and can’t wait to see the impact they make!
Play Leaders
Our dedicated team of Play Leaders support all of our pupils at play time and lunch time to have a successful, positive experience. Our Play Leaders work closely with Mrs French, our HLTA, to ensure they are equipped to lead and support their peers during social times of the day. Our Play Leaders offer suggestions for new games and even work with Mrs King to keep our play equipment well-stocked and exciting!
Librarians
Our Librarians work with our English Lead to help keep our Library organised, attractive and tidy. The librarians organise each section of the library into categories and monitor stock levels. They are fantastic advocates of reading and are great at recommending new books to read!

Pastoral Care
At Thornton Grove Academy, we understand that nurturing the well-being of our pupils is paramount to their academic success and personal growth.
Our dedicated team of professionals is committed to creating a supportive and inclusive environment where every pupil feels valued and heard. Through regular one-on-one work, group activities and a strong sense of community, we foster emotional resilience, empathy and social skills. At Thornton Grove Academy, pastoral care is not just a programme; it's a cornerstone of our educational philosophy, ensuring that each pupil thrives academically, emotionally and personally.
